Specification: This module is a small test specification for a data-structure generator, as stated by the comments. It models a set of message records `msgs` together with an integer `seqno`, first constraining an initial prepared state in which `seqno` and `msgs` are generated and every message in `msgs` has a smaller sequence number than `seqno`. It then defines a test action that adds a new message record with the current `seqno` and some existentially chosen integer ballot, increments `seqno`, and states an assertion that message ballots are monotone with respect to sequence numbers.
